responsibility: This file simulates target-memory layout for constant Fortran expressions inside the front end. It computes scalar and aggregate storage sizes, encodes constants and constructors into target byte representations, interprets raw bytes back into gfc_expr values for integers/reals/complex/logicals/characters/derived types, merges overlapping EQUIVALENCE initializers, and performs BOZ-to-real bit-pattern reinterpretation, providing the target-layout bridge used by constant folding, DATA handling, and constant lowering.
same_name_distinction: Implements target-memory simulation algorithms: size computation, byte encoding/decoding of constants, derived-type and array interpretation, EQUIVALENCE initializer merging, and BOZ bit-pattern conversion. Unlike gcc/fortran/target-memory.h, it is the concrete machinery rather than the API declaration surface.
